title: T107 (Tinyana) PNC - The Ta'avah Ha-Klalis — Unlike Achilah, This One Loses Strength
hebrewTitle: מאוס והרחקת התאוה הכללית — עצם החיות מתחסר ע"י
author: Pettek Nanach

beginner.en: **Pa'am echas dibber mei-inyan ma'us ve-harchakas ha-ta'avah ha-klalis, she-hi ta'avas ni'uf.** *Anah ve-amar*: **Hinei achilah — al kol panim nis-toseif la-adam koach ve-chiyus al-yedei zeh — aval zoiss ha-ta'avah, ha-loi adraba, hi mafsedes u-mazekes ha-chiyus me'oid u-meshatah kocho shel adam me'oid.** *Look at the structure of the two ta'avois that the body craves most.* **Eating** — *al kol panim* — *adds koach and chayyus*; even when it is over-indulgent and harmful in other respects, the *immediate input* is *strength gained*. **But the ta'avah ha-klalis** — *adraba, mafsedes u-mazekes ha-chayyus me'oid u-meshatah kocho shel adam me'oid*. The very *organism* loses koach through it. **Be-vadai ein tzrichin osah klal, ki im bi-shvil kiyum ha-min le-vad.** Therefore there is *no need at all for this ta'avah, except for kiyum ha-min* — and even that only *bi-shi'ur*.

intermediate.en: **Re'ayah pnimis le-divrei Rabbeinu**: ha-ta'avah ha-klalis = *adraba, mafsedes u-mazekes chiyus shel adam me'oid u-meshatah kocho*. *Achilah* — *nis-toseif chiyus*; aval ta'avas ni'uf — *me-chaseir* — *be-vadai ein tzrichin osah klal ki im bi-shvil kiyum ha-min le-vad*.

scholarly.he: [T2:107א] התאוה הכללית (ניאוף) — אדרבה: מפסדת ומזקת חיות האדם, מתשת כוחו. אכילה — מוסיפה חיות. אין צורך בה אלא לקיום המין.
